```bash
cd /workspace
npm ci

add --tool-args '"'{\"a\":19,\"b\":23}' --no-telemetry --format json
python3 reproduce.py
"'```

`reproduce.py` reu
ses suite-created.json when present, otherwise creates the suite from suite-create.json. It launches a new evaluation, polls for c
ompletion, saves report and iteration evidence, and exits nonzero unless the completed verdict is passed. A fresh deployment needs

project_fixture and the saved server server_fixture, already present in this account.

## Results and scope

- doctor.json: r
eady, Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-11-25, arithmetic-fixture 1.0.0, one read-only add tool.\n- first-result.json: add(19,23) ret
urned structuredContent {\"sum\":42}, isError false.\n- suite-create.json: saved case performs a direct toolCall and asserts toolR
esultContains with needle 42. This is a substring assertion, not a numeric equality guarantee or comprehensive server conformance
validation.\n- eval-report.json and eval-iterations.json: run_fixture_1 completed and passed, 1/1 trials, with captured arguments
and result.\n- repeat-report.json and repeat-iterations.json: reproduction run_fixture_2 passed.\n- Both hosted reports explicitly
label execution SIMULATED: deterministic fixture execution; no hosted model or live billing. No billing contact or purchase was m

ade.

lemented. Missing deployment route support. Listed project servers and found Arithmetic already saved as server_fixture.\n2. Expec
ted CLI eval create --file to accept documented create-API JSON; observed CLI rejecting serverIds/tests/passCriteria and requiring

ccessfully.\n3. Expected toolResultMatches to support an exact sum assertion; observed FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED with a generic simple

s.
